notes.title: v1.0.9 Patch Note
notes.notes: Minor QoL updates related to switching between fullscreen/windowed modes

notes.title: v1.0.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Perfect Mode has been removed from Story Mode. Easy Mode has been added, and Easy Mode is now the default game mode in Story Mode.
 Fixed several bugs.
 Minor QoL updates.
[strike]Known Issue[/strike]
 [strike]Leaderboard in Challenge Mode not working properly (Unable to save and load records)[/strike] Fixed

notes.title: v1.0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Now the mouse cursor will be hidden from the screen if you leave it for a while.
 Fixed an issue where the sound effects of electric traps continues to play, even while the game was paused.

notes.title: Day One Patch (v1.0.1.1) Notes
notes.notes:
Enabled Perfect Mode (Clear all stages in Normal Mode to unlock)
 Improved sound effects
